title: Ben Kamtzar
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned disparagingly in Yoma, chapter 3, mishnah 11, because he would not teach the art of writing. The Gemara there, 38b, says that he held four quills between his fingers and wrote a four-letter word all at once.

notes.text: The Mishnah records the refusal to teach. The Gemara describes the four quills and the simultaneous writing.
